notes: NEVER use the-saleroom.com (or collect any house through it): its terms (cl. 3.2, 6.1) forbid systematic downloading and spidering.
Rules per house are in docs/RULES.md. Houses that RULES.md marks Unclear stay enabled:false until someone has read their terms by hand and updated RULES.md.
crawl_delay is in seconds (never below 3; 10 where robots.txt says so).
adapter must be a name from collector/sources/__init__.py. An enabled house whose adapter is not written yet is simply skipped.

goauction houses also need calendar_urls (pages listing the sales; {month} is replaced by YYYY-MM). Optional: sale_include, sale_exclude, max_pages, max_lots_per_sale, max_new_lot_pages (default 150 new lot pages per run), calendar_months. See collector/sources/goauction.py.

keep_existing_lots: true keeps a house's stored lots (until their sales end) while it is switched off only because its adapter is not written yet. Without it, switching a house off removes its lots at the next run.
